description: Assessment of Tornado Loading on Low-Rise Buildings Using Computational Modeling and Tornado Simulator Testing is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Delong Zuo, Texas Tech University (ttu.edu). Tornadoes are a type of severe windstorm that repeatedly have caused devastating damage to the built environment in the United States. Low-rise buildings, in particular, historically have been among the structures that are the most vulnerable to tornado damage. Coverage: National Wind Institute (VORTECH). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: tornado, wind loading. Published 2022-10-12. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
